formulas.aborted_scope_attempts: 6 attempts on the IncompleteRead-aborted row (1 UNKNOWN + 5 REJECTED, zero SETTLED) explain the entire 699-693=6 gap

field_definitions.provider_calls(row): provider attempts extracted from the agent runtime events for that row (settled + unmetered)
field_definitions.settled_requests: unique request_ids whose final state is SETTLED in the proxy ledger
field_definitions.unknown_bound_cny: worst-case reservation for RESERVED/SENT requests without SETTLED/REJECTED (cost unknown)
field_definitions.token_limitations: the source proxy ledger does NOT persist per-request token buckets or pricing tier; the round total is independently recomputed from SETTLED cost_cny values plus the UNKNOWN reservation bound; row-level aggregate input/cache_read/output token buckets exist only in auditable_tasks.jsonl and cannot be mapped back to each proxy request, so per-request token-level repricing is NOT independently reproducible
field_definitions.sensitivity_artifacts: sensitivity.json is regenerated by scripts/analyze_r19_cluster_sensitivity.py (exact DP sign-flip, post-hoc); the manifest records the script and output SHA-256 but neither hashes this manifest
field_definitions.intervention_text_retention: raw request/response bodies, full provider payloads, credentials and raw session logs are excluded; the selected intervention_text is intentionally retained for action-level auditability
field_definitions.seq: 0-based transition index preserving source-file order within each run
